From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Subject: Novum Health — POC kickoff notes & next steps

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the intro call today — appreciate the context on your summaries and the high-level goals for retrieval-augmented workflows on patient-facing support. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan: 

- Objective: validate 95th%-tile latency at your typical query length and verify redaction/PII handling for sample datasets.
- Diego/Redwood to provision a short-lived POC environment (dedicated pool) and provide a simple test harness.
- Novum infra: confirm network egress rules and give a small set of representative test queries (anonymized).
- Timeline suggested: kickoff window next week (Mon/Tue) for infra readiness + two-day smoke test.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (POC checklist & roles).

Can you confirm who from your infra/security team we should loop in and whether the week of Sep 28 works for kickoff? If preferred, we can also do a guided 2-hour bootcamp with our engineer to speed onboarding.

Thanks — I’ll hold a small dedicated pool for a few days once we lock the window.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
 diego@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Technical checklist + minimal network requirements (POC)

Hi Lauren — following up from Diego’s note and the attached checklist. I’m the Customer Engineer who’ll run the bootcamp if you opt for it. Two quick items we need to confirm before the guided session:

1) Network egress — open outbound 443 to our inference endpoints; if you prefer IP allowlist I’ve attached network-requirements.xlsx with the CIDR blocks.
2) Test data — a small set of anonymized queries (10–20) to validate latency and redaction.

Other optional items: SSO (SAML/OIDC) and KMS key access for customer-managed encryption. If you can share a point person for infra/security, I’ll tailor the session to their access level.

Attachments: network-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Lauren Mitchell <lauren@novumhealth.ai>

Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novum Health POC kickoff — stalled setup, offer: short bootcamp

Hi Diego / Monica — apologies for the delay. We’ve had a few internal shifts and our infra team is facing a capacity crunch this quarter. A couple of notes:

- Security asked for a SOC 2 attestation and a short audit trail example before they’ll sign off on any external endpoints. Can you point me to the SOC 2 report or a security summary?
- Our infra lead is on a project stretch and cannot free time for a guided bootcamp this month. We won’t be able to allocate the cluster until mid-October at the earliest.

That said, we’re still interested — I can coordinate a follow-up in two weeks to pick this back up. Also, would Redwood be able to run a 2-hour virtual bootcamp for our product and platform teams (no infra required) so we can validate the integration patterns before allocating infra? If so, please suggest dates. I’ll also loop procurement (procurement@novumhealth.ai) for NDA/POC paperwork.

Thanks — Lauren Mitchell
VP, Product — Novum Health
lauren@novumhealth.ai

Thanks for the update, Lauren — totally understood and appreciate the clarity. Quick responses to your points plus a couple of options: 

- SOC 2 / security: here’s a short summary and the signed SOC 2 report: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f (see Security > SOC2_Report.pdf). If your security team wants specific audit log examples we can produce a sanitized excerpt.
- Bootcamp option: we can run a 2-hour virtual session that focuses on integration patterns and the product team-level flows (no infra changes needed). Proposed windows next week:
  • Wed 6 Oct, 10:00–12:00 PT
  • Thu 7 Oct, 11:00–13:00 PT

I’ll also send a short DocuSign NDA link to your procurement contact to speed paperwork: https://www.docusign.com/novum-nda/abcdef. If you prefer, we can do the bootcamp without an NDA and restrict attendees to product staff.

Finally, we’ll keep a small dedicated pool reserved through Oct 12 to make scheduling easier; if we don’t hear back by then we’ll release the hold but keep the HubSpot deal active.

Would either of those bootcamp windows work? If so I’ll lock a calendar invite and share a short agenda.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
